issues.detail: Fact 4 states 'The agreed date of possession was 1 January 2023' as a specific date, but FACTS only states the promised year was 2023 ('promised possession in 2023'); no specific date of 1 January 2023 appears in FACTS or client's words.
issues.fix: Replace '1 January 2023' in Fact 4 (and wherever else it is stated as the agreed possession date, including in the sections table row for 2(69) and next_steps item 6) with '[TO CONFIRM — specific agreed possession date in 2023]'. The date_of_cause in FACTS is the system-computed cause-of-action date, not a contractually agreed possession date confirmed by the client.

issues.detail: Section 69 row in the sections table and next_steps item 6 repeat '1 January 2023' as the cause-of-action date used to compute the limitation deadline '1 January 2025', but this specific date is not in FACTS or client's words.
issues.fix: Replace '1 January 2023' in the Section 69 'why' and in next_steps item 6 with '[TO CONFIRM — agreed possession date]' so the limitation calculation is not asserted as fact until the actual contractual date is confirmed.

issues.fix: Replace '[Place]' with '[TO CONFIRM — place of verification]'.
